description: MCP Resource — common household maintenance schedules. Reference as @household-tools://maintenance-templates to get recommended intervals without a tool call. Use tools (get_items_due, add_item) to act on this data.
note: Lesson 2.4: This is a resource (application-driven, read-only, no model overhead) not a tool. The agent reads it to answer 'how often should I replace my HVAC filter?' without an API round-trip.

templates.name: HVAC filter
templates.notes: More frequent with pets or allergies (30–60 days)

templates.name: Smoke detector test
templates.notes: Replace batteries annually; replace unit after 10 years

templates.name: Carbon monoxide detector
templates.notes: Replace unit every 5–7 years per manufacturer

templates.name: Water heater flush
templates.notes: Extends tank life; reduces sediment buildup

templates.name: Gutter cleaning
templates.notes: Spring and fall; more if trees overhead

templates.name: Dryer vent cleaning
templates.notes: Fire prevention — lint buildup is a leading cause

templates.name: Refrigerator coil cleaning
templates.notes: Improves efficiency; coils are behind or underneath

templates.name: Garbage disposal cleaning
templates.notes: Ice cubes + rock salt, then citrus peel

templates.name: Car oil change
templates.notes: Or per manufacturer — typically 5,000–7,500 miles synthetic

templates.name: Chimney inspection
templates.notes: Required if used regularly; NFPA 211 standard

templates.name: Whole-home air filter
templates.notes: Thicker media (4–5 inch) lasts longer — check manufacturer
